arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Smith's lawyer argued the judge found Smith not guilty. He claimed this gave Smith final protection. He said the judge's later change violated double jeopardy.
Massachusetts's lawyer argued the trial court could correct its error. She said the prosecution needs a fair chance to prove its case.
Justice Breyer questioned the timing of the acquittal. He asked when it becomes final for double jeopardy purposes.
Justice Kennedy asked why a state court cannot act like a statute does. He questioned the difference between legislative and judicial action.
